question: Who knows man-Maya interval, momentary, from kala-abode action-turning?
premises: from moment, of person, of kala — man-Maya-interval knower
inference: Moment-person-kala interval-knowing turns wholly from kala-abode action.
plain_english: From moment, of person, of kala — man-Maya-interval knower; of kala-abode even completely, from action turning away.
